compiled_state.title: T4(UPDATE): Update reviewer-base.md and agent files: add auto-downgrade warning for missing relation
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode: UPDATE (instruction files — non-executable)

Update the three agent instruction files to add the auto-downgrade consequence for missing or unjustified relation field on cycle ≥ 2 findings. This is additive — files already reference the relation taxonomy via review-findings-schema.md.

## Files
- plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md
- plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-light.md
- plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-standard.md

## Change
In the Schema contracts section of each file (where the relation field taxonomy is already referenced), add the following enforcement note:

'IMPORTANT (cycle ≥ 2 enforcement): The runner auto-downgrades findings where relation=NEW_INTRODUCED but cited_lines do not overlap any prior defense's ±5-line window AND escape_rationale is missing or fails the three-criterion check (review-findings-schema.md:203-211). Consequence: any cycle ≥ 2 finding you mark NEW_INTRODUCED without a qualifying escape_rationale will be downgraded to suggestion regardless of severity. When your finding overlaps a prior defended region, use RESUSTAIN_OF or REFRAME_OF with prior_finding_id to avoid auto-downgrade.'

## Scope
- Add only the enforcement note. Do NOT restructure existing guidance.
- Do NOT duplicate relation taxonomy definitions — they are already in the schema contract reference.
- No conflict with Story A T5 (which only touches REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md, not agent files).

## Acceptance
- All three files contain the enforcement note
- Additive only — no existing text removed or modified
